fisherman.name: Fisherman
dialog: A rod reaches the Pokémon that never come up onto the bank. Cast, wait, and pull the moment it bites.
Psyduck and Golduck swim in this water. Between them they've stolen half my bait.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Fisherman Andrew: Every one of my Pokémon came out of this water. Want to meet the lot of them?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Fisherman Andrew: One of these days one of them will grow into something fearsome. You just wait.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Fisherman Joseph: Shh, you'll scare the fish! ...Oh, go on, then. One battle, and back to my line.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Fisherman Joseph: My Goldeen's horn is sharp, but you were sharper today.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Fisherman Zachary: Not a single bite all morning. A battle will pass the time!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Fisherman Zachary: Lost the battle and still no fish. It just isn't my day.
